newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish reverse repo drains 62 bln SKR from market.
newsitem.headline: Swedish reverse repo drains 62 bln SKR from market.

text.p: Sweden's central bank, the Riksbank, said on Tuesday it drained 62 billion crowns from the market in this morning's reverse repurchase operation.
The reverse repo was set at an unchanged fixed rate of 5.15 percent and will run from September 18 for seven days.
It replaces an operation, also set at 5.15 percent, that drained 61 billion crowns from the market.
The Riksbank said 14.16 percent of the bids for the tender were allocated.
